title: U.S. and Iran resume indirect talks as Strait of Hormuz, the world's key oil waterway, stays mostly closed
summary: Envoys shuttled via Qatari mediators at the U.N. General Assembly to seek a starter framework, but a three-way deadlock over Iran retaining control versus U.S. insistence on pre-war free passage keeps tanker flows far below pre-war levels and leaves prices elevated.
